predecessor_mapping_repairs.text: Profit from effort or activity exerted in Lebanon. Holding and offshore companies pay no income tax on profits or on profit distribution; offshore companies also have no stamp duty on overseas contracts signed in Lebanon and no payroll tax on 30% of foreign employees' basic salary, and pay payroll tax on staff working in Lebanon ([IDAL](https://www.investinlebanon.gov.lb/en/doing_business/tax_system)). Inventory (2023, 2024) and fixed-asset revaluation got an extra three months; the Ministry's review deadline runs to 31/12/2030 (Budget 2026 art. 40).

PIT-15.rule: Business450m personal deduction,225m spouse,45m per dependent child at most5. Male child through18 or through25 for university; disabled male without paid work requires specified Ministry certificate; female child before marriage or widowed/divorced. Both working spouses each single deduction and equal child shares; separated husband paying maintenance; non-wage-working father/taxable-working mother allocation stated beside amounts. Not a salary allowance.
